gates.name: Identity and least privilege
remainingActions: Assign the production IAM owner and deploy one write-capable authority identity per prefix plus read-only consumer identities.
Run the credentialed ACL-negative test, secret injection/rotation and redacted-log review against the actual production tenant.

gates.name: Time and authority failure policy
remainingActions: Assign the authority/on-call owner and prove the production clock-skew bound, publication-age alerting and cadence against the shortest lease TTL.
Rehearse authority restart, loss, republish and reviewed failover/recovery with readers failing closed.

gates.name: FoundationDB durability and recovery
remainingActions: Record the production FoundationDB replication/storage policy, pinned images, keyspace compatibility and service-failover owner.
Complete backup/restore, disk/process/power-loss and clean-environment recovery drills with measured RPO/RTO.

gates.name: Production-like workload and soak
remainingActions: Run production-shaped multi-chunk, partial-write, truncate/extend, fencing, lease-expiry, reconnect and fresh-client workloads at agreed duration/load.
Record latency, retries, errors, resource growth, capacity headroom, cost envelope and error-budget result with an accountable performance owner.

gates.name: Observability and operations
remainingActions: Assign the on-call owner and publish dashboards/alerts for cluster health, authority age/errors, lease fencing, transaction retries, block errors and space pressure.
Exercise the incident, escalation and recovery runbook end to end and retain acknowledgement evidence.

gates.name: Rollout and rollback
remainingActions: Assign the release owner, define canary holdback and explicit go/no-go/abort criteria, and verify keyspace/configuration compatibility.
Rehearse rollback and authority recovery in the production-like environment before any consumer is enabled.

gates.name: Hosted and platform evidence
remainingActions: Assign the platform/package owner and complete the advertised macOS/Linux native-client, Node, CLI, FUSE/NFS/FSKit and clean-install matrix.
Retain signed/package provenance and terminal evidence for every advertised platform; hosted Linux qualification alone is insufficient.
